Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner uncritically accepted the parenthetical claim that the director of “The Gallant Lords of Bois-Doré” was André Hunebelle and built the plan around Hunebelle without verifying the film’s director. This led the workflow to research Hunebelle’s death rather than the actual director of the work (e.g., Bernard Borderie for the 1976 TV miniseries), resulting in a wrong final answer. The first occurrence of this assumption appears in Step 2 (“Updated Understanding”).
